stories.title: Investors turn on Google owner Alphabet after profit miss, ad slowdown and high spending
stories.take: Alphabet missed on profit — net income fell 25% to $26.2B despite $127.6B revenue — and shares dropped more than 10% after hours as ad growth slowed and AI spending stayed huge.

stories.title: Microsoft just shared Azure’s actual revenue in dollars: $33.2 billion
stories.take: Microsoft disclosed Azure's dollar revenue for the first time — $33.2B in the quarter — putting hard numbers on how close it is to AWS.

stories.title: Microsoft recorded $10 billion in revenue from OpenAI
stories.take: Microsoft booked $10B from its OpenAI arrangements in one quarter, a reminder of how financially intertwined the two still are.

stories.title: Upwind raises $400M after walking away from Datadog acquisition offer
stories.take: Upwind raised $400M at a $3.8B valuation after walking away from a Datadog acquisition offer at roughly the same price — betting it is worth more independent.

stories.title: Apple’s touchscreen MacBook Pro pushes laptop pricing to a new extreme
stories.take: The new touchscreen MacBook Pro tops out around $14,549 fully loaded — the OLED touch Mac is also Apple's most expensive laptop ever.

stories.title: Massive Leak Exposes 41,000 Homeland Security Workers—Including Undercover ICE Agents
stories.take: A leak published data on 41,000 Homeland Security workers, including undercover ICE agents, facility locations and personal phone numbers.

stories.title: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, its latest frontier AI model that you can't use
stories.take: Google's Gemini 4 Carbon is a slightly better take on its Argon frontier model — and, for now, one you cannot actually use.

stories.title: Google expands AI Search ads globally as core ad growth slows
stories.take: As core ad growth slows, Google is taking AI Search ads global, monetizing the AI answers that are eating the old results page.

stories.title: Google Stock Sinks as AI Mode Pressures Search Ad Growth
stories.take: Adweek's read of the Alphabet miss: AI Mode is pressuring the search ad engine, and Google is pushing more ads into AI answers to compensate.

stories.title: Condé Nast’s Q4 Ad Business Is Forecast to Fall Short by Over $35 Million
stories.take: Condé Nast's Q4 ad business is forecast to miss by more than $35M, with insiders pointing to senior sales departures and no clear commercial strategy.

stories.title: Sephora casts Seth Rogen for holiday ads targeted at gift-givers
stories.take: Sephora cast Seth Rogen as a clueless shopper in holiday ads aimed at gift-givers who do not know beauty but want to get it right.

stories.title: Apple’s Safari crackdown pushes ad tech toward server-side solutions, but doubts remain
stories.take: Apple's latest Safari tracking limits are pushing ad tech toward server-side frameworks like IAB Tech Lab's Trusted Server — with plenty of doubt it solves the problem.

stories.title: Creators are now classified as small businesses, but what does that actually mean?
stories.take: The SBA now classifies creators as small businesses, which could change how brands contract, pay and support the creator economy.

stories.title: What influencer fatigue says about creator-driven marketing’s next phase
stories.take: Influencer fatigue is the signal: creator marketing's next phase is fewer, more credible partnerships instead of constant sponsored volume.

stories.title: Coca-Cola gives everyday heroes the royal treatment in posh portrait campaign
stories.take: Coca-Cola gave everyday heroes the royal-portrait treatment in a posh new campaign — classic Coke warmth, executed like fine art.

stories.title: Giannis wins first with Heat behind 24-18 night; Bam sets rebounding mark
stories.take: Giannis got his first Heat win with 24 points and 18 rebounds, on the night Bam Adebayo became Miami's all-time rebounding leader.

stories.title: Top pick Dybantsa scores 19 points in NBA debut for Wizards
stories.take: No. 1 pick AJ Dybantsa scored 19 to lead Washington in his NBA debut — a strong first night for the Wizards' top pick.

stories.title: Pacers' Haliburton out at least 2 weeks with hamstring strain
stories.take: Tyrese Haliburton is out at least two weeks with a hamstring strain, the latest injury hit in a brutal first week for NBA stars.

stories.title: Wolves say Edwards will be 'good as new' after knee surgery
stories.take: Minnesota says Anthony Edwards will be 'good as new' after arthroscopic surgery on his lingering right knee injury.

stories.title: Hornets bench Reid at half for not meeting 'our standards'
stories.take: Charlotte benched Reid at halftime for not meeting 'our standards' — an early-season message from the Hornets' bench.

stories.title: OKC's Williams has surgery, to be reevaluated before end of season
stories.take: Oklahoma City's Williams had surgery and will be reevaluated before the end of the season, thinning the Thunder's rotation.

stories.title: Kerr, Finch want NBA to alter how it calls flopping techs
stories.take: Steve Kerr and Chris Finch both want the league to change how flopping technicals are called — the first-week crackdown is already drawing pushback.

stories.title: Williamson keeps Rays alive in WS; Caminero '100%' set for Game 5 despite injury
stories.take: The Rays stole Game 4 in the 12th to avoid a sweep, and Junior Caminero says he is '100%' for Game 5 despite his injury.

stories.title: Brewers lose 1st postseason game in 21 days: 'This stuff is not supposed to be easy'
stories.take: Milwaukee was three outs from its first title before Tampa Bay stormed back in the 12th — the Brewers' first postseason loss in 21 days forces Game 5.

stories.title: Brewers' Murphy defends decision to save ace Misiorowski for Game 5
stories.take: Pat Murphy defended saving Jacob Misiorowski for a Game 5 start instead of closing Game 4: the ace starts the title-decider.

stories.title: 2026 MLB playoff bracket: Schedule and scores as Brewers take second shot at first World Series title
stories.take: Game 5 sets up simply: Milwaukee gets a second shot at its first World Series title, Tampa Bay needs to win out to finish the comeback.

stories.title: Walter keeping Dodgers 'no matter what' amid ongoing federal probe
stories.take: Mark Walter says he is keeping the Dodgers 'no matter what' amid an ongoing federal probe — a firm hold statement from the owner.

stories.title: ⚾ What Jackson Chourio and Junior Caminero bring to this World Series
stories.take: Chourio and Caminero, the two young faces of this Series, now headline a winner-take-all-style Game 5 spotlight.

stories.title: Fed holds interest rates steady even as inflation remains stubborn
stories.take: The Fed held rates steady in its last decision before the midterms, with inflation still above 3% and investors now expecting a December hike.

stories.title: ‘They mobilized a whole government response to that joke’: Obama laughs off Trump attacks in rally for Ossoff
stories.take: Obama closed for Democrats in suburban Atlanta for Jon Ossoff and Keisha Lance Bottoms, laughing off Trump's attacks: 'These are not serious people.'

stories.title: Utah files criminal charges against prediction market Kalshi and company co-founders
stories.take: Utah filed felony criminal charges against Kalshi and its co-founders over its gambling ban — a new, harder tactic by states against prediction markets.

stories.title: Trump calls for prosecution of Alaska Senate candidate Peltola over Sullivan name controversy
stories.take: Trump called for prosecuting Alaska Democrat Mary Peltola after reports her campaign helped recruit a second candidate named Dan Sullivan.

stories.title: New polls suggest surprising Democratic gains in red-state Senate races
stories.take: New polls show surprising Democratic gains in red-state Senate races in the final days, even as Trump rallies in Ohio for a race that could decide the Senate.

stories.title: Trump administration will allow pharmacies to make popular peptides
stories.take: The administration will let pharmacies make popular peptides, with RFK Jr. overruling FDA scientists who opposed easing access.

stories.title: Forecasters are predicting a warmer and wetter winter. Here's how El Niño will affect your region.
stories.take: Forecasters expect a warmer, wetter winter driven by El Niño — the regional breakdown decides who gets rain and who gets a mild season.

stories.title: What's next for Israel after election produces political gridlock
stories.take: Israel's election produced gridlock with no clear governing path — PBS walks through what happens next.

stories.title: Judge denies feds' request to block 20,000 California ballots in blistering opinion
stories.take: A judge denied the federal bid to block 20,000 California ballots in a blistering opinion; the DOJ immediately said it will appeal.

stories.title: Tributes pour in for labor leader Dolores Huerta: ‘Fought for farm workers to the very end’
stories.take: Tributes poured in for Dolores Huerta, who died at 96 after seven decades fighting for farmworkers 'to the very end.'

stories.title: Los Angeles approves ban on oil production after years-long fight
stories.take: Los Angeles approved banning new oil drilling and phasing out production at some 600 active wells over 20 years, ending a years-long fight.

stories.title: Record-breaking high tides spark chaos – and kayak commutes – across California
stories.take: Record high tides flooded streets, homes and train routes from San Diego to the Bay Area — some coastal residents commuted by kayak.

stories.title: Castaic's Chiquita Canyon landfill blamed for headaches, dizziness and wheezing, says state lawsuit
stories.take: California is suing Chiquita Canyon Landfill's operators, blaming mismanaged hazardous waste for headaches, dizziness and wheezing in Castaic.

stories.title: Investigators find Victoria's Secret wear, guns, cash and 9 suspected train bandits with cartel ties
stories.take: Investigators arrested nine suspects with alleged Sinaloa cartel ties in a cargo-train theft ring, seizing guns, cash and stolen retail goods in San Bernardino.

stories.title: Your last-minute voter guide to California's 2026 general election
stories.take: Election Day is close: this last-minute guide covers what is actually on California's 2026 general election ballot.

stories.title: The Downfall of Weil Gotshal
stories.take: Century-old elite law firm Weil Gotshal is planning to dissolve after partner defections, profit growth of just 3-4% vs a 14% top-100 average, and losing top rainmaker Michael Iello • The Fed held rates steady, but Lisa Cook and Beth Hammack dissented for a hike, signaling a possible December move • Trian's $1.4B bid sent Wendy's shares up over 15% • Also: doubts over China's claimed 4.5% Q3 growth, Bolsonaro's flight to Miami, and Spain's train crash killing at least 68

stories.title: Amazon built the Trojan Horse for your smart home
stories.take: The Trojan Horse is the Echo Frame — a $200 photo frame people actually want, with Alexa riding inside it; the Echo Time alarm clock works the same way • The flagship Echo Show 16 ($499, $399 on preorder) is a family hub that finally lets you pin one persistent screen — calendar, photos, Fire TV or smart-home dashboard — instead of rotating ads • Amazon under Panos has flipped strategy: good, expensive hardware for Alexa fans, not cheap disposable Dots (the Dot is now $100, up from $50) • Also new: an Echo Studio with a 13MP camera ($250) and Alexa Cards that turn chats into visual cards — where suggestions veer back into ads

stories.title: Earnings Special: Alphabet Disappoints Wall Street on Revenue & Income
stories.take: Alphabet missed across the board: revenue ex-TAC $111.21B vs $111.29B expected, Search $63.35B vs $64.85B, and shares fell more than 7.5% after hours • The core debate: AI is driving search use up 12%, but monetization is not keeping pace • Google Cloud was the bright spot at $30.71B vs $29.1B expected • Free cash flow was -$9.1B against Microsoft's roughly +$19B, even with CapEx lighter than feared at $51.36B

stories.title: AI Can Now Create Worlds You Can Change in Real Time
stories.take: Google's Genie 4 world model lets users change simulated worlds in real time — live prompts add objects and characters, change weather and steer the scene, with generation windows doubled to about 2 minutes and native audio • Anthropic bought one-person biotech Mithril Medicine, which took a muscular-dystrophy treatment from concept to promising mouse results in 18 months vs a typical 4-7 years • Anthropic holds $112B in cash ahead of a possible record IPO • Google processed about 25 trillion tokens in the 72 hours after Gemini 4 Argon

stories.title: Catalina Island internet delays,  LA phases out oil drilling, Preview of shuttle Endeavour — Evening Edition
stories.take: Catalina Island's internet plans are delayed and up in the air • Los Angeles is moving to phase out oil drilling • The billionaire-tax debate continues: a proposed one-time 5% tax and Prop 40 have split Democrats, with some wealthy residents considering leaving • Plus a preview of shuttle Endeavour and the American French Film Festival, 60-plus films from November 3

stories.title: Fed holds rates, but a future hike is pretty inevitable
stories.take: The Fed held rates steady, but Chair Warsh signaled a future hike is likely — 'We will deliver price stability,' no ifs or buts • Small businesses are holding off borrowing at current rates, with alternative financing at 8.5-10.5% filling some of the gap • Student-loan debt now tops $1.9 trillion, with borrowers paying $1,100-$1,200 a month reshaping how families live • Holiday spending is forecast to rise 4.2% to over $1 trillion
